##: Template. The release workflow fills version, url and hash from the published release and SHA256SUMS.txt, then pushes the result to dragoscv/scoop-vitals as bucket/vitals.json. Scoop does not run the NSIS installer: 7-Zip unpacks it (the #/dl.7z suffix), which gives a portable copy with no Program Files entry, no service and no uninstaller registration. See packaging/winget/README.md for the other channels.
description: A modern, fast system monitor and task manager for Windows.
notes: Vitals is installed as a portable copy. Settings live in %APPDATA%\Vitals and survive 'scoop uninstall'.
Update with 'scoop update vitals'. The app's own updater installs the full per-machine version instead, so prefer Scoop for updates.
